reviewer: Codex, actual opened Godot evidence; causes qualified by saved mesh audit

mob_meadow_wolf: Recognizable wolf and stable sampled motion. Fur geometry and face projection remain soft; bounded torso smoothing plateaued, original retained.
mob_ironhide_boar: Promising armored rest silhouette. Severe running limb sheets; assisted reweighting worsened underside. Preserve hide; matched anatomy and limb skin rebuild required.
fern_reference: Source fused opaque fronds. Corrected joined leaflet rebuild improves separation and canopy after sparse first pass was rejected.
watchtower: Bent supports and missing readable ladder. Corrected trimmed joined supports retain roof/balcony; first protruding-post pass rejected.
mob_young: Bark is intentional. Thin body, detached foliage and large foot/hand fans in running; anatomy and skin correspondence unresolved.
mob_bristle_boar: Readable brown boar at rest, but large forelimb sheets in run quarter poses. Eyes/tusks soft. Skin/anatomy correspondence requires local rebuild.
mob_blue_wolf: Recognizable silvery wolf; sampled running remains readable. Surface bumps and indistinct eyes need local geometry/texture work, not global normals.
mob_grown: Tree hide appropriate. Thin torso and fused foliage; running hands and feet stretch into fans.
mob_reed_spider: Every clip sheet opened: short reed legs remain readable in attack/death/hit/idle/run, with a small disconnected side fragment. No broad running sheets like copper or widow. Preserve anatomy, inspect/remove only proven isolated debris.
mob_red_wolf: Head faces opposite the rig-compatible blue wolf; severe moving front/hind limb sheets. Inspect mesh coordinates against head/leg bones before yaw correction.
mob_grey_wolf: Head faces opposite the rig-compatible meadow wolf; large running limb sheets. Saved mesh and bone correspondence must establish orientation cause.
mob_ironback: Woody armor intentional. Lower body fused and feet fan in run; preserve promising chest, rebuild matching articulated lower limbs.
mob_mire_boar: Mud armor and head are promising; running creates extreme limb/tusk sheets. Weight normalization does not prove anatomical compatibility.
mob_copper_spider: Readable copper carapace and rest legs. Motion stretches legs into broad strips; joint correspondence needs local skin/leg rebuild.
mob_moonfang: Dark blue wolf retains recognizable silhouette and readable run samples. Eyes/fur detail soft in both geometry and projection.
mob_road_bandit: Very thin side profile, elongated face and fused weapon; severe cloth/leg fans. Prepare separated neutral-pose reference rather than smoothing incompatible anatomy.
mob_thicket_wolf: Leaf-covered brown wolf suits concept and sampled running reads correctly. Preserve fur/leaf features; only localized surface/eye detail work.
mob_blacktusk: Recognizable dark boar, comparatively readable running without the extreme sheets seen in ironhide. Small paw artifact and weak tusk/eye definition remain.
mob_venom_spider: Green carapace suits concept. Running underside/legs form sheets; rebuild leg regions after explicit skin/anatomy inspection.
mob_slate_guardian: Rocky hide is intentional; massive fist and chest readable. Thin side profile and long running foot sheets require matching lower-limb anatomy.
mob_hollow_raider: Hood silhouette recognizable frontally but paper-thin body, fused weapon and severe running cloth sheets. Neutral separated reference needed.
mob_cinder_wisp: Skull, ember body and separated trailing swirl recognizable; sampled motion stable. Transparent fire/material detail remains soft; intentional floating pieces retained.
mob_frost_wolf: White ruff and muzzle readable, sampled running stable. Small geometric pinholes and soft eyes need local repair; global smoothing would erase fur.
mob_silk_matron: Concept long articulated legs became short fused appendages and broad abdomen. Running abdomen stretches into sheets; rebuild matching legs/skin.
mob_ash_bandit: Thin side profile and fused held blade, running skirt/legs form large fans. Front appearance alone does not meet human anatomy target.
mob_grave_wisp: Turquoise spectral ribbons and floating body appropriate, motion stable. Material clarity and torso emblem soft; intentional openings are not accidental holes.
mob_ember_hound: Rocky ember fur suits lava concept; recognizable hound and readable running. Eye/emission contrast can improve without flattening hide.
mob_cairn_sentinel: Segmented rocky arms/torso recognizable. Running feet stretch into long sheets, requiring articulated lower-limb correspondence.
mob_glass_spider: Rest spider readable, but concept translucent crystal distinction lost and moving legs become flat strips. Skin and material regions need separate attention.
mob_dusk_stalker: Dark crouched wolf retains silhouette and readable run. Hide noise blends with dark projection; inspect UV allocation before face repaint.
mob_bloodfang: Red mane and muzzle recognizable and run samples readable. Face definition and local rough surface need polish, preserving intentional mane.
mob_ash_wisp: Long spectral standard and swirl match concept structure; motion stable. Ember core/material contrast weak, not a structural hole defect.
mob_obsidian_boar: Promising armored lava boar at rest; running front legs and underside stretch badly. Preserve rocky hide; matched joint anatomy needed.
mob_widow_spider: Dark red abdomen and spider outline readable at rest; walking legs stretch into broad sheets rather than articulated limbs.
mob_exile_captain: Captain armor front recognizable but body/weapon fused and very thin; running cloth and feet form large fans. Isolated neutral reference needed.
mob_storm_wisp: Tattered floating standard and blue ribbons recognizable; motion stable. Improve core/blue material contrast, retaining intended fragments.
mob_rift_sentinel: Violet segmented stone body suits concept, lower feet produce elongated moving sheets. Lower-limb rebuild required, not smoothing stone plates.
mob_ancient_warden: Mossy stone body appropriate but fused lower limbs and severe running sheets. Preserve torso; matching leg anatomy required.
mob_cairn_colossus: Heavy stone chest and arms retained; source lower legs already thin/disconnected, motion creates feet sheets. Missing articulated structure is not shading.
hero_ironvow: Armor, head and red skirt useful. All clips opened in readable crops: sleeve fans during attacks/skill_plant and calf/cloth fans in run. Rebuild local skin correspondence while preserving face, torso, clip names and sockets.
horse_bay: Bay rest proportions and separate tack are promising. Actual walk/trot/canter previews show forehoof triangular fans. Diagnose lower-leg joint correspondence and rebuild local weights; generic run row did not exercise horse gaits.
tree_pine: Trunk/canopy structure recognizable but foliage is opaque angular clumps rather than fine needles. Rebuild canopy regions with separated leaf geometry, preserve trunk.
rock_slate: Slate silhouette, grounded shape and textured rock surface appropriate; organic irregularities harmless at gameplay distance.
shrub_reference: Opaque fused canopy with broad planar facets rather than separate leaves. Leaf-region remodel required, texture resolution alone cannot create gaps.
house_reference: Readable tiled roof, timber/plaster separation and grounded walls. Small roof/post irregularities visible close up but coherent at gameplay distance.
npc_keeper: Robe front readable but nearly flat profile and projected, malformed face. Reference isolation and consistent neutral views needed; normals cannot restore volume.
dead_tree: Branch silhouette, broken crown and bark appropriate; intentional dead branch openings and mild organic irregularities retained.
fallen_log: Readable grounded log, end grain and bark; small irregularities appropriate to decayed wood.
npc_smith: Apron/front readable but very thin body and stretched projected face; concept heavy smith volume absent. Isolated neutral reference needed.
shrine: Roofed stone pile and open posts recognizable. Slight post waviness and soft tile texture need local architectural polish; central opening intentional.
tent: Canvas A-frame and intentional entry opening retained, silhouette and fabric read at gameplay distance.
ruin_arch: Arch opening is intentional, ruined masonry coherent. Thin profile and soft stone relief need local depth/detail polish; no global hole filling.
npc_stablemaster: Outfit front reads but profile nearly flat and face projection malformed; recover volume with consistent isolated neutral reference.
grass: Individual blades became opaque folded sheets. Rebuild blade canopy rather than smooth fused mass or upscale its texture.
fracture: Open thorn ring and orange suspended core recognizable. Roots appropriately noisy; improve core material contrast, preserve intentional openings.
crate: Crate planks and brace read at gameplay distance. Skewed corners and soft top grain need limited structural/texture polish.
bridge: Useful deck and posts, but rope rails are largely missing and deck droops asymmetrically. Rebuild rail/post regions while preserving collision traversal.
